column3: “Conduct a case with the mountains” is rendered “plead your case before the mountains.”
“For” is rendered “Indeed,” and “a house of slaves” “the house of slavery.”
“Planned” is rendered “counseled,” and “righteousnesses” “righteous acts”; NASB keeps the elliptical “from Shittim to Gilgal.”
“Come to meet” is rendered “come to,” and “calves sons of a year” “yearling calves”; “God of height” is rendered “God on high.”
“Torrents” is rendered “rivers,” and “transgression” “rebellious acts”; “belly” is rendered “body,” and “self” “soul.”
“Humankind” is rendered “man,” and “covenant loyalty” “kindness”; “be modest to walk” is rendered “walk humbly.”
“Success will see your name” is rendered “it is sound wisdom to fear Your name,” reading a different verb; “whoever appointed it” is rendered “Who has appointed its time?” The meaning is uncertain.
“House of the wicked” is rendered “a man in the wicked house,” and “an ephah of scantness” “a short measure.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Will I be clear” is rendered “Can I justify.”
“Which” is rendered “For”; NASB supplies “of the city.”
“I will make sick by striking you” is rendered “I will make you sick, striking you down.”
“Emptiness” is rendered “vileness,” and “carry away … not bring to safety” “try to remove for safekeeping, But you will not preserve anything.”
“May be kept” is rendered “are observed”; “horror” is rendered “destruction,” and “hissing” “derision.”
